title: release-opencode-plugin

goal.text: Publish a verified OpenCode plugin release.

requirements.summary: Release only the OpenCode adapter artifact family without npm publication.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the OpenCode adapter fourth segment is bumped.
Focused OpenCode checks and the guarded release verifier pass.
The exact vopencode-<version> tag and GitHub Release are verified.

tasks.title: Inspect and classify the OpenCode baseline
tasks.detail: Read AGENTS.md and references/artifact.md; inspect branch, remotes, tags, manifests, and every worktree change.

tasks.title: Prepare the OpenCode adapter
tasks.detail: Bump only the adapter fourth segment, synchronize required content, and review the complete diff.

tasks.title: Verify the OpenCode candidate
tasks.detail: Run focused adapter and bundle checks, template/shared-skill checks, and git diff --check.

tasks.title: Pass the exact-source gate and release
tasks.detail: Commit intended content on main, push origin/main, require an empty worktree and HEAD == origin/main, run npm run verify:release, create and push vopencode-<version>, and create the GitHub Release.

tasks.title: Verify the OpenCode release
tasks.detail: Verify tag, GitHub Release artifact evidence, repository cleanliness, and only the separately authorized platform installation refresh.

rules: Never publish npm packages or modify another artifact family.
Stop at the first failed release boundary.
